name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.220: Everything the plugin adds to the Jellyfin web interface (badges, buttons, the downloads list, messages, the player overlay) now takes its colours, corner shapes and font from the theme in use, including community themes and Custom CSS, and follows a theme change at once. Text is checked to stay readable on its background. Theme authors can set --federation-* variables to override any of it.
